data.description:
## Context

Follow-on epic to sue-tribe-skid (4100-95a4-07ce-41ab — Pre-surfacing reviewer-findings verifier agent F4+F5 bundle). The verifier sub-agent emits `downgrade-to-minor` rulings on findings that are true-but-misclassified (severity inflated, scope wrong). In sue-tribe-skid, these rulings ship to a normal minor PR comment with no resolution attempt — chosen for ship-without-blocker reasons. This epic builds the proper minor-finding ticket gate (Approach 4 from the post-PR-#103 calibration analysis) and re-routes verifier `downgrade-to-minor` rulings through it once the gate exists.

## Approach (placeholder — to be developed in /dso:brainstorm)

1. Build a minor-finding ticket gate that converts qualifying minor findings (verifier-downgraded plus reviewer-emitted minors meeting a maturity rubric) into low-priority tickets in the DSO ticket tracker rather than PR comments.
2. Re-route `code-reviewer-verifier` `downgrade-to-minor` rulings through this gate (replace the SC6 normal-minor-PR-comment path from sue-tribe-skid).
3. Define the rubric for which minor findings become tickets vs ephemeral comments (signal-to-noise calibration).

## Dependencies

- 4100-95a4-07ce-41ab (sue-tribe-skid) MUST close first — this epic depends on the verifier sub-agent and its `downgrade-to-minor` ruling shape being live in production.

## Out of scope

This is a placeholder epic. /dso:brainstorm will refine the spec, success criteria, and approach before /dso:preplanning runs. Do not implement directly.
data.title: Approach 4: minor-finding ticket gate + reroute verifier downgrade-to-minor
